app_tagline: [മലയാളം] Speak your problem. We find your scheme.
consent_body: [മലയാളം] We collect only minimum details to match you with government schemes. Voice recordings are kept securely for 30 days and then automatically deleted. You can delete your data at any time from Settings.
mode_selection_title: [മലയാളം] How would you like to use Umeed?
mode_text_badge: [മലയാളം] For those who can read and type
mode_text_subtitle: [മലയാളം] Type your details in a familiar form.
mode_audio_prompt: [മലയാളം] Press the orange button to speak, or the blue button to type.
q_gender: [മലയാളം] Are you a woman, a man, or other?
q_state: [മലയാളം] Which state do you live in?
q_area: [മലയാളം] Do you live in a village or a city?
q_caste: [മലയാളം] Which category do you belong to? (General, OBC, SC, ST). You may skip this.
q_income: [മലയാളം] About how much does your family earn in a year?
q_occupation: [മലയാളം] What work do you do? (Farmer, student, laborer, homemaker, business, other)
q_disability: [മലയാളം] Do you have any disability? You may skip this.
q_family: [മലയാളം] How many people live in your family?
q_need: [മലയാളം] What kind of help do you need most? (Farming, education, health, housing, money, jobs)
caste_why: [മലയാളം] Certain government schemes provide special grants, subsidies, or reservations specifically for SC, ST, or OBC categories.
income_why: [മലയാളം] Many schemes are meant for families below specific income limits or BPL thresholds.
disability_why: [മലയാളം] Special pensions, assistive devices, and quotas exist for persons with disabilities.
handoff_title: [മലയാളം] Your recordings have reached a helper
handoff_desc: [മലയാളം] A trained civic helper is reviewing your voice responses to complete your profile.
busy_day_desc: [മലയാളം] Our helpers are currently busy. We have scheduled a confirmed callback slot for you tomorrow.
reminder_scheduled: [മലയാളം] We will send an SMS and notification 15 minutes before your slot.
profile_ready_notification: [മലയാളം] Your profile is ready! Tap to view your ranked schemes.
docs_locked_notice: [മലയാളം] Documents unlock after speaking to the Help Desk or choosing to skip.
skip_help_desk: [മലയാളം] I already understand, skip to documents
physical_office_address: [മലയാളം] Or visit nearby CSC / Gram Panchayat office
no_proxy_notice: [മലയാളം] Umeed does not submit applications on your behalf. We guide you to the official window.
delete_data_confirm: [മലയാളം] Are you sure? This will erase your profile and cached voice recordings immediately.
disclaimer: [മലയാളം] Disclaimer: Umeed is an informational and guidance tool. Final eligibility and approvals are decided solely by the respective government authority.
q_sector_focus: [ml] Which area or sector do you need help in? (Finance, Agriculture, Health, Housing, Education, Jobs, Pension)
choose_gist_language: [ml] In which language would you like your scheme summary and gist?
query_help_desk: [ml] Have a question about this scheme? Ask the Help Desk
type_query_hint: [ml] Type or speak your question for the helper...
